name: Robin's Exclusive W-Engine
desc2: Equip to increase Defense Agents' combat capabilities

1.name: Robin Test Engine
1.desc: When the equipper applies a shield, the whole squad's DEF increases by 10% for 10s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a maximum of 25s. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad. When the equipper launches an Aftershock, the whole squad's DMG increases by 10% for 15s, stacking up to 2 times. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

2.name: Robin Test Engine
2.desc: When the equipper applies a shield, the whole squad's DEF increases by 11.5% for 10s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a maximum of 25s.
